ocr.ready: Images are read automatically when added.
ocr.noenglish: English text recognition is not installed, so mod names may be less accurate (add English in Windows Settings → Language to improve it).
ocr.title: Image reading results
ocr.fail.items: Could not read (run "Data Update" to also match Warframe and weapon names)
ocr.forma.display: {n} (the number after "{name} [{rank}]" at the top of the screen)
ocr.forma.est: {n} (estimated: number of slots with matching polarity)
ocr.note: Reading is an estimate; check before saving. The Forma estimate assumes mods are max rank and that a matching polarity halves the cost, and it also counts innate polarities as one.
ocr.filled: Filled in {list}. Fields already filled were not changed, except the Forma count shown on screen.
ocr.unchanged: Fields already filled were not changed.
ocr.engine.title: Text recognition
ocr.engine.lead: Choose the text recognition used to read game screens and build images. High-accuracy recognition (PP-OCRv6) is available after installing its components (tens to over a hundred MB).
ocr.engine.rt.pyver: Not yet available for this Python ({tag})
